name: Shepherd-1
subtitle: Laser-ablation debris-remediation pathfinder
status: Proposed. Pitch-stage system design; no hardware exists. Figures are first-order budgets, not a flight analysis.
classification: ESPA-Grande-class spacecraft on a commercial bus core with mission-specific power and thermal subsystems

lineage.article: The Case for Attack Satellites, sections 6-8 (populationmars.com/blog/the-case-for-attack-satellites)
kept_from_article: head-on engagement rule: fire only on targets approaching from ahead so recoil lowers perigee
loiter 50 km below the target band so a failed shepherd decays first and J2 drifts the plane for free
supercapacitor pulse storage sized by power, not energy
Hall-effect propulsion with a locked disposal reserve
changed_from_article: scale: 480 kg pathfinder instead of the 2.3 t production unit, so it fits a commercial ESPA-Grande bus and a rideshare launch
laser: 20 J, 10 Hz, 1 ns, 200 W UV (nearest lab analogue HiLASE Bivoj THG: 50 J at 10 Hz at 343 nm) instead of 700 J, 100 ps, 3.3 kW
engagement range: 5-12 km in co-orbital shepherd formation instead of 60-300 km sweeper passes
targets: catalogued 1-50 kg fragments at 700-900 km, to measure coupling and prove the concept, not tonne-class derelicts

orbit.rationale: Continuous sunlight for most of the year powers the laser without large batteries; 50 km below the 800 km target band so the shepherd decays first and differential J2 precession (7.9 deg/yr) walks it between target planes for no propellant.
orbit.disposal: Hall-thruster lowering to 300 km (248 m/s, 43 days continuous at 35 mN) with locked 8.8 kg xenon reserve; natural decay from 750 km alone would exceed the FCC 5-year rule, so the second thruster string is the disposal backup.

body_frame.x: +X ram (velocity). Hall thrusters exhaust along +X to lower the orbit.
body_frame.y: -Y sun side (dawn-dusk orbit keeps the Sun near -Y); +Y anti-sun, radiators.
body_frame.beam: Beam director points aft (-X), at the target the shepherd flies ahead of.

dimensions_m.launch_interface: 24-inch (610 mm) ESPA Grande port, Lightband-class separation system
dimensions_m.envelope_note: Within the Moog ESPA Grande nominal port envelope (1.07 x 1.17 x 0.97 m) and 700 kg qualified port mass; above the 300 kg included mass of a SpaceX rideshare XL plate (extra mass purchasable).

laser.architecture: Yb:YAG master oscillator + diode-pumped multi-slab power amplifier at 1030 nm, third-harmonic generation in LBO to 343 nm, no pulse compressor
laser.enclosure: sealed, pressurized housing with oxygen partial pressure (EarthCARE ATLID heritage) and zeolite molecular-adsorber panels (ICESat-2 heritage) to stop laser-induced contamination of UV optics
laser.pulse_power: supercapacitor bank delivers ~450 J per 1 ms quasi-CW pump pulse (~0.4 MW peak) to the diode stacks; bank is sized by current and cycle count, not energy
laser.heritage_gap: Highest average optical power flown is ~25 W (CATS); highest UV ~3.5 W (Aeolus ALADIN); highest pulse energy ~0.2 J (CALIPSO). Shepherd-1 is ~100x beyond flown pulse energy and ~60x beyond flown UV average power. Nearest ground analogue: HiLASE Bivoj third harmonic, 50-55 J at 10 Hz at 343 nm, 53-64 % conversion. The laser is the critical-path development item.
vendor_candidates: HiLASE / STFC CLF DiPOLE architecture licence

optics.beam_director: 0.45 m silicon-carbide primary (Mersen Boostec class, ~5 kg at 30 kg/m2), Cassegrain afocal expander, dielectric HfO2/SiO2 high-reflector coatings for 343 nm
optics.gimbal: two-axis elevation-over-azimuth yoke recessed in the aft cradle; azimuth +/-100 deg, elevation -25/+70 deg; hollow axes carry a coude beam path from the fixed laser bench
optics.fine_steering: 55 mm space-qualified fast steering mirror (BlueHalo / AeroVironment / CEDRAT class), +/-5 mrad, >800 Hz, closed on target return light
optics.pointing_budget: bus 35 urad (0.002 deg, 1 sigma) -> gimbal with inertial reference (LCRD heritage) -> FSM holds the 1.4 urad half-spot at 10 km
optics.aperture_door: motorised contamination door, closed during thruster burns and outgassing phases
optics.coude_path: beam rises through the hollow azimuth axis, folds through one hollow elevation trunnion onto the telescope axis

tracking.acquisition_telescope: 15 cm off-axis visible telescope, 1.5 deg field, V~15 limiting magnitude at short exposure (MSX SBV / Sapphire class); body-fixed, aft-looking
tracking.fine_tracker: narrow-field visible tracker through the main 0.45 m aperture via dichroic; centroid feeds the fast steering mirror
tracking.thermal_ir: uncooled LWIR camera on the gimbal for eclipse tracking (ADRAS-J heritage)
tracking.ranging: low-energy pulses from the main laser (1-5 J, 343 nm) with a photon-counting receiver on the main aperture; 1 m range precision at 10 km
tracking.catalogue: targets are catalogued objects; TLE / Space-Track ephemeris for approach, onboard angles-only navigation from hundreds of km (ADRAS-J heritage)
tracking.laser_safety: firing interlock requires: target track confirmed on fine tracker, protected satellites >0.1 deg off the beam axis beyond the target (OrbitFleet rule), USSF Laser Clearinghouse window open, Earth limb >100 km below the line of sight

power.array: two roll-out blanket wings (Redwire ROSA Diamond class, 3.3 kW / 36 kg flown on DART), 1.1 x 5.0 m each, 11 m2, fixed sun-facing (-Y) in the dawn-dusk orbit, deployed along +/-Z
power.battery: 2.5 kWh lithium-ion (eclipse season and safe mode)
power.supercapacitors: 20 kg bank, ~50 kJ, ESA-EPPL-listed cell class (Nesscap) or Skeleton SpaceCap

thermal.approach: mechanically pumped single-phase loop from the laser cold plates to two deployable radiator panels (Airbus deployable-radiator / loop-heat-pipe heritage) plus the body anti-sun face
thermal.deployable_radiators: two panels 2.0 x 0.85 m hinged from the anti-sun (+Y) face edges, both faces radiating, 6.8 m2, optical solar reflectors
thermal.insulation: multi-layer insulation with germanium- or ITO-coated outer Kapton (atomic oxygen and charging), survival heaters, louvers on the electronics radiator

propulsion.thrusters: two 600 W-class xenon Hall thrusters (Busek BHT-600 / SETS ST-40 / Astra ASE class), prime and redundant, on a two-axis thrust-vector platform at the ram face
propulsion.propellant: 24 kg xenon in a 25 L COPV; 8.8 kg disposal reserve locked by software and a separate latch valve
propulsion.plume_keepout: 45 deg half-angle cone about +X; radiators, arrays and optics all lie behind the thruster exit plane
propulsion.attitude_backup: no chemical RCS; wheels plus magnetorquers handle momentum; safe mode is sun-pointed with arrays fixed

adcs.wheels: four 4 N m s reaction wheels (Blue Canyon RW4 class) in a pyramid, isolated from the optical bench
adcs.star_trackers: two heads (Sodern Auriga / BCT NST class), anti-sun and zenith-aft baffles
adcs.sun_sensors: fine sun sensors on the sun face and coarse sensors on all faces
adcs.magnetorquers: three 30 A m2 rods for wheel desaturation
adcs.gnss: dual-antenna space GNSS receiver, 1 PPS to laser timing and crosslink terminal

comms.crosslink: one SDA-compatible optical terminal (Mynaric CONDOR Mk3 / CACI CrossBeam / Tesat SCOT80 class), 2.5 Gbps to 6,500 km, hemispherical gimbal on the zenith face; fleet mesh and Kepler optical relay
comms.ttc: S-band CCSDS transponder, two hemispherical patch antennas (zenith, nadir)
comms.downlink: X-band transmitter, 140 Mbps, nadir patch array: tracker imagery and the per-target firing log
comms.relay: L-band GEO relay terminal (Viasat InRange / Addvalue IDRS class) for anytime low-rate command and abort during engagements
comms.data_products: published firing log per target: time, range, pulse energy, energy on target, measured orbit change

structure_and_mechanisms.primary_structure: aluminium-honeycomb / CFRP facesheet panels on a machined aluminium frame; aft cradle for the gimbal
structure_and_mechanisms.mmod: stuffed Whipple bumper on the ram face over the xenon tank and laser bench
structure_and_mechanisms.hdrm: non-explosive actuators (EBAD NEA 9100 / TiNi Frangibolt class) on both wings, both radiators, the gimbal and the aperture door
structure_and_mechanisms.cold_welding: dissimilar metal pairs at every separable contact, sputtered MoS2 dry film on HDRM interfaces, Braycote 601EF in gimbal bearings, ceramic-coated latch pins (Galileo HGA lesson)
structure_and_mechanisms.charging: ITO-coated outer MLI, single-point ground, conductive array blanket backsheets (polar auroral zone)
structure_and_mechanisms.radiation: 2-4 mm aluminium-equivalent electronics enclosures; ~5 krad/yr at 1.85 mm Al at 800 km SSO

pathfinder_goals: deorbit several catalogued 1-50 kg fragments from the 700-900 km band
measure delivered impulse per joule on real, tumbling, mixed-material debris
measure UV optics degradation per shot under an oxygen-bled enclosure
demonstrate the fleet crosslink and the published firing log

subsystems.label: Bus structure
subsystems.summary: 1.0 x 0.95 x 0.85 m ESPA-Grande-class body, 24-inch separation ring, aft cradle for the gimbal, MMOD bumper on the ram face.
subsystems.vendors: Apex Nova / York LX-CLASS / Airbus US Arrow 450 / True Anomaly Jackal class bus core

subsystems.label: Beam director
subsystems.summary: 0.45 m SiC Cassegrain on a two-axis yoke gimbal, fast steering mirror, contamination door, coude feed from the laser bench.
subsystems.vendors: Mersen Boostec SiC; BlueHalo / CEDRAT FSM; LCRD-class gimbal with inertial reference

subsystems.label: Laser
subsystems.summary: 20 J, 10 Hz, 1 ns, 343 nm. Yb:YAG multi-slab amplifier + LBO third harmonic in a pressurized O2-bearing enclosure. 2 kW in, 200 W UV out.

subsystems.label: Tracking sensors
subsystems.summary: 15 cm acquisition telescope, narrow-field tracker through the main aperture, LWIR camera, laser ranging receiver.
subsystems.vendors: SBV / Sapphire-class telescope; ADRAS-J-class camera suite

subsystems.label: Solar arrays
subsystems.summary: Two roll-out blanket wings, 1.1 x 5.0 m, 11 m2, 3.6 kW BOL / 3.05 kW EOL, fixed sun-facing.

subsystems.label: Radiators
subsystems.summary: Two deployable 2.0 x 0.85 m panels on the anti-sun face, 6.8 m2 both-sided, pumped-loop fed, 2.25 kW rejected at 300 K.
subsystems.vendors: Airbus deployable radiator / loop heat pipe heritage

subsystems.label: Propulsion
subsystems.summary: Two 600 W xenon Hall thrusters on a thrust-vector platform at the ram face, 25 L xenon tank, 570 m/s budget, locked disposal reserve.
subsystems.vendors: Busek BHT-600 / SETS ST-40 / Astra ASE

subsystems.label: Attitude control
subsystems.summary: Four reaction wheels, two star trackers, FOG IMU, magnetorquers, fine sun sensors, dual GNSS.
subsystems.vendors: Blue Canyon RW4; Sodern Auriga; Northrop LN-200S

subsystems.label: Communications
subsystems.summary: SDA-compatible optical crosslink terminal (2.5 Gbps, 6,500 km), S-band TT&C, X-band downlink, L-band GEO relay.
subsystems.vendors: Mynaric CONDOR Mk3 / CACI CrossBeam; Syrlinks EWC31 / EWC27; Viasat InRange

subsystems.label: Avionics & power electronics
subsystems.summary: Flight computer, payload processor, laser safety interlock, PCDU, 2.5 kWh battery, 20 kg supercapacitor bank.
